proposal.utterance: Classify 'agent connectedness' as a kind of entity.

entities.label: AgentConnectedness
entities.rationale: Agent connectedness denotes a measurable, bearer-specific property of an agent or set of agents — the degree or manner in which agents are connected to one another or to an institution. This fits BFO Quality (BFO_0000019) as a specifically dependent continuant that inheres in its bearer(s) and is intrinsically characterizing. It is not a role (externally conferred social function) nor a disposition (internally grounded capacity), but rather a relational quality that characterizes the agent(s) at a time. If the user intends it as a capacity or tendency toward connecting, Disposition (BFO_0000016) would be an alternative.

relations.rationale: AgentConnectedness is proposed as a subclass of Quality (BFO_0000019), a specifically dependent continuant that inheres in a bearer and characterizes it.

open_questions: Is 'agent connectedness' intended as a static relational quality (e.g., the degree to which agents are currently linked) — supporting Quality (BFO_0000019) — or as a capacity/tendency of agents to form connections, which would favor Disposition (BFO_0000016)?

Does 'agent connectedness' inhere in a single agent, a group of agents collectively, or in the relational structure between agents? This affects whether the bearer is an individual, a collective material entity, or a generically dependent continuant like RelationalStructure.
Is this intended to be a sub-kind of any existing working class such as RelationalCoherence (BFO_0000019) or RelationalStructure (BFO_0000031)?
proposal.rationale_summary: The utterance asks for a BFO classification of 'agent connectedness' as a kind (i.e., a class). The most defensible first-pass typing is Quality (BFO_0000019) because connectedness names a specifically dependent property that characterizes an agent or set of agents at a time — it is not a process, not a generically dependent information artifact, and not a role. The closest existing working class is RelationalCoherence (also typed as BFO_0000019), but agent connectedness is more general and agent-focused rather than system-coherence-focused, so a new class is proposed. Disposition (BFO_0000016) is flagged as an open alternative if the user intends a capacity rather than a state.
